body:
Each lands as its own package under `packages/`, registered in `apps/chrome-ext/` via the renderer registry. Order TBD by demand:

- `@viewers/json` — `.json`, `.jsonc` → virtualized tree + raw tab + jq-lite filter box
- `@viewers/code` — `.ts`, `.tsx`, `.js`, `.jsx`, `.yaml`, `.toml`, `.css`, `.html` → Shiki highlight, copy, fold, line anchors, wrap toggle, `.diff` / `.patch` support
- `@viewers/csv` — `.csv`, `.tsv` → table, filter, sort, column toggle
- `@viewers/image` — `.svg`, `.png`, `.jpg`, `.webp` → zoom, pan
- `@viewers/log` — `.log`, `.txt` → monospace + grep / highlight box
